about_the_game:
IMPORTANT NOTE - YOU DO NOT NEED TO PURCHASE THIS DLC IF YOU ALREADY OWN THE JESTER CHARACTER FOR TALISMAN: DIGITAL CLASSIC EDITION. SIMPLY SIGN INTO YOUR NOMAD ACCOUNT ON BOTH GAMES AND IT WILL UNLOCK FOR YOU IN-GAME.

Step into the spotlight, bringing your own brand of misdirection and merriment! The Jester returns to 5th Edition, but he’s more than just a simple trickster—his wit and whimsy transform every duel into a dazzling performance. With a flourish and a well-timed jest, the Jester captivates royalty and commoners alike, turning the tide of battle in his favor.

Purchase this character pack to add the Jester to your character collection in Talisman: Digital 5th Edition.

Character Stats

  • Strength - 2

  • Craft - 4

  • Fate - 4

  • Lives - 5

  • Alignment - Good

  • Start - City

Special Abilities

  • When you are attacked by another character, your constant juggling causes a distraction and they must reduce their attack roll by 1 (to a minimum of 1).

  • Instead of attacking a character, you may impress them with your skills and take one gold from them.

  • Whenever you encounter a creature, you may try to confuse it. Roll one die and add your fate. If the total is higher than the creature's Strength or Craft, you may evade it. If you fail to confuse the creature, you must attack it as normal.

  • Whenever you visit the City, Tavern or Village, instead of encountering the space, you may perform there and earn one gold.

  • Whenever you visit the Castle, you may heal up to your life value for free.
